resources.string: Allows approved Aegis Eye Agent management actions for this enrolled device, including locking the device when requested by the authorized account.
Allows user-approved Aegis Eye Agent remote touch actions only during active support/control sessions for an enrolled device.

Aegis Eye Agent is for authorized management of devices you own or are permitted to administer. It may request Android Device Owner provisioning for theft-resistant management, Device Admin for lock actions, Accessibility for remote touch control, Camera for live camera sessions, Screen Capture for live screen viewing, Location for device location, and Files access for requested file transfer. Continue only if you consent to enroll this device.
